# Toolbar native with-FAB source fixtures

Seven unchanged licensed originals at AndroidX revision
`a095da93f8e98dea8748ceed79ea8427aade245f`; `sources.json` records exact URLs/SHA.

- `intrinsic-oracle.json.gz`: 100 original native/Row/Column/default-modifier
  intrinsic query groups, including unbounded queries.
- `layout-oracle.json.gz`: 40,320 original native with-FAB modifier trees,
  including 1,784 expected source-invalid constraint combinations.
- `no-fab-oracle.json.gz`: 2,520 original natural balanced-padding constructor
  and omitted inner Row/Column default trees, including FAB-removal geometry.

The tenth content profile is a wholly generic single child; zero-cross bounds
check source scroll extent without native hit-bound overflow contributing area.

Shared full Row/Column, icon size/minimum-interactive, coordinator, constraints,
scroll and placement originals remain independently hash-verified in their
existing fixture sets. Reproduction and exact source/host/browser boundaries:
`tools/androidx-toolbar-fab-content/README.md`. Neither these fixtures nor their
browser checks establish full Compose/runtime/platform equivalence.
